title: Require approval before replaying a recorded browser workflow
brief: Update the workflow recorder so a recorded workflow remains a draft until a named human approves it. Require non-empty handoff notes during approval and preserve who approved the plan. A draft or rejected workflow must never be replay-ready.
acceptanceCriteria: A newly recorded workflow is not replay-ready.
Approval requires a non-empty approver and handoff notes.
An approved workflow records the approver and becomes replay-ready.
A rejected workflow remains unable to replay.
Automated tests cover draft, approved, invalid approval, and rejected states.
npm test and npm run build pass.
